scores.evidence: Both mermaid diagrams (s1-diagram, s3-diagram) are flowchart TD, and their Japanese labels are readable at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-04.png, pages/mobile-jp-12.png, pages/mobile-jp-13.png). The definition tables s1-defs and s3-defs stack cleanly on mobile. No overflow, broken images or mermaid errors.

No text-only screens on desktop or mobile. Prose is broken up by definitions, diagrams, code, steps and an inline check in every segment (pages/mobile-jp-05.png, pages/mobile-jp-10.png, pages/mobile-jp-17.png). Desktop JP median is 39 chars per line, inside the 30-40 target.

All learner-visible text is Japanese, and English appears only as glossed terms and code. Contrast is good on the light cards and on the dark code blocks. The long chips (disable-model-invocation: true, .claude/skills/<名前>/SKILL.md) stay whole and readable at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-09.png, pages/mobile-jp-10.png, pages/mobile-jp-24.png). Controls are not hidden under the top or bottom bars.

niceToHave: s2-skill: at 390 px, source line 12 (`git status` と `git diff HEAD` で、) soft-wraps so that only 「で、」 sits on a continuation row (pages/mobile-jp-06.png). The text stays readable. Moving 「で、」 to the start of line 13 would avoid the orphan.

practice: on mobile the section heading 「演習：自分の手順をスキルにし、調べものを任せる」 breaks after 「スキルに」, leaving 「し、」 at the start of line 2 (pages/mobile-jp-18.png). A shorter title such as 「演習：手順をスキルに、調べものを任せる」 would break more naturally.
pr-after: the step title 「⑦ もう一度 /context を見て比べる」 wraps after /context next to the 完了 checkbox on mobile (pages/mobile-jp-21.png). This is minor; 「⑦ /context で再確認する」 would fit on one line.
reader: the mobile full-length PNG is truncated at 16000px, so the per-screen PNGs were used. 14 failed /api/ requests were ignored as environment noise.
summary: Clean visual run: no overflow, console, mermaid, block or image errors, and no text-only screens. Both TD diagrams and the definition tables are readable at 390 px, and the reworked code blocks and inline chips wrap readably. No personal data on any screen. Nothing must be fixed; only small mobile line-break tweaks in s2-skill, the practice heading and step pr-after are suggested.
